passages.provision_quote: commencing January 1, 2023, the division shall not approve any notice of intention under Section 3203 within a health protection zone
passages.note: The bar on new drilling approvals runs only inside a health protection zone, defined as "the area within 3,200 feet of a sensitive receptor", so new drilling stays available elsewhere in the state.

rows.reasoning: Gonzalez authored SB 1137 (2021-2022), which bars the division from approving new notices of intention inside a "health protection zone", the area within 3,200 feet of a sensitive receptor. That restricts new drilling in one geographic band while leaving it permitted elsewhere, so it does not match "Allow no new drilling and let production decline over time", and it is further from "Phase out fossil fuel production entirely" or "Keep fossil fuel production steady at current levels". The record shows the restrictive side of the ladder without separating the rungs on that side.
